clue.text: One takes the lead, it's assumed by churchmen

definitions.meaning: a pet's neckband is where the leash clips on
clergy put on a stiff white band at the neck

explanation.definitionFit: A clerical neckband shares its name with the band a pet wears for its leash, so both readings fit.

clue.text: Curtains in short supply lacking rayon primarily

indicators.note: lacking tells us a letter is dropped from the word for scarcity

parts.note: a scarcity of something is a dearth

indicators.note: primarily picks out the opening letter of the word rayon

explanation.surface: A drapery shop has run short of curtains, being without rayon fabric.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Curtains' is slang for the end, i.e. death; DEARTH loses R, the first letter of 'rayon'.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying it's curtains for someone is slang for their end, their demise.

clue.text: Good girl on trial that's just for show

parts.note: a lass is a girl
a court case is a trial

explanation.surface: A good girl is in court, but the trial is merely theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: A glazed display cabinet holds items purely to be looked at.

clue.text: Man on boundary with rifle, due to get new order

indicators.note: the letters are told to take up a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A soldier posted at the frontier with a gun is due for fresh instructions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'get new order' rearranges RIFLE and DUE TO. In cricket, a fielder on the boundary is in the outfield.
explanation.definitionFit: A cricket fielder placed far out near the boundary rope plays in the outfield.

clue.text: General hospital area that's sheltered

parts.note: Robert E. Lee was the Confederate general
a ward is a section of a hospital

explanation.surface: A general hospital has a section that is protected from the elements.
explanation.definitionFit: The downwind side, away from the wind, is the protected side.

clue.text: Absolute fortune to share out again

parts.note: real can mean absolute, as in a real disaster
one's lot is one's fate or fortune

explanation.surface: An entire fortune is to be redistributed among heirs.
explanation.definitionFit: To allocate once more is to divide and distribute a second time.

clue.text: Namely how to move a caravan

definitions.meaning: a legal-sounding phrase introducing a specification, that is to say
a caravan is hauled behind a car, so you pull it along

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase meaning 'that is to say' also splits as instructions to haul the trailer.

clue.text: A very small measure for you, being old

definitions.meaning: one thousandth of an inch, an engineering unit

explanation.definitionFit: The word names a thousandth of an inch and is also the archaic singular form of 'you'.

clue.text: Wife cut slice of the cake

parts.note: to hack is to cut roughly

explanation.surface: A wife cuts herself a piece of cake.
explanation.definitionFit: One's share of the proceeds is colloquially one's portion or cut.

clue.text: Class divisions, basically

parts.note: the basic split in a class-conscious society, the bosses versus the rest of us

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase sums up an adversarial social split into two opposing camps.

clue.text: A short celebration on one's own

indicators.note: short means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: a party is a celebration

explanation.surface: A brief party, enjoyed alone.
explanation.definitionFit: Being separate from others means being alone or aside.

clue.text: Complicated, so give details

definitions.meaning: to expand on or explain more fully, as a verb

explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means intricate; as a verb it means to expand on something.

clue.text: Friendly sort of shop, one with food

indicators.note: sort of signals the letters of shop are rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a table can mean the food served, as in keeping a good table

explanation.surface: A welcoming kind of shop provides a single table for eating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort of' rearranges SHOP into HOSP, then I (one) and TABLE (food, as in 'keeps a good table').
explanation.definitionFit: Being welcoming and generous to guests is being warmly hospitable in manner.

clue.text: Seabirds return to find another

indicators.note: return says the word for the birds is read backwards

parts.note: auks are diving seabirds such as puffins

explanation.surface: Seabirds come back to discover a further one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' means another seabird: AUKS turned back gives a predatory gull-like bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A great skua is a predatory gull-like bird, so it is a further seabird.

clue.text: Blair clashes with Iran's "Book-keepers"

indicators.note: clashes suggests the two names collide and scramble together

explanation.surface: A British prime minister quarrels with Iran's accountants.
explanation.walkthrough: The quoted 'Book-keepers' suggests accountants, but read literally it means people who keep books in a lending collection.
explanation.definitionFit: Staff who look after a lending collection of volumes literally keep books.

clue.text: Not running, like horses in the stable

definitions.meaning: of an engine, having cut out

explanation.definitionFit: An engine that has cut out has stopped; horses kept in stalls are housed in them.

clue.text: Stand firm, partly thanks to new alliance

indicators.note: partly says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A new alliance helps one hold one's ground.
explanation.definitionFit: To block or resist doggedly is to refuse to budge.

clue.text: Pinched some chicken the boy swallowed

indicators.note: swallowed means one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: Ted is a boy's name
a wing is a portion of chicken

explanation.surface: A boy gulped down some stolen chicken.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling a sharp sudden pain, a pang, is like being pinched.

clue.text: Inadvisable subject for oral examination

parts.note: a free present you should not inspect by looking in its mouth, as the proverb says

explanation.definitionFit: The proverb warns against looking in the mouth of a present animal, i.e. checking its teeth.

clue.text: Two bats in demand at picnics

definitions.meaning: the pair of batsmen who begin a cricket innings
tools for uncorking bottles and opening tins

explanation.definitionFit: Batsmen who start an innings, and gadgets for uncorking bottles, share the same name.

clue.text: It has us squirming, this massage

indicators.note: squirming suggests the letters wriggle into a new order

explanation.surface: This massage has us wriggling.
explanation.definitionFit: A Japanese finger-pressure therapy is a kind of massage.

clue.text: Transport may be safe with these containers

parts.note: a car is a means of transport

indicators.note: may be suggests the letters of safe could appear in another form

explanation.surface: Travel might be secure with these containers.
explanation.definitionFit: Glass jugs for wine or water are vessels for holding liquid.

clue.text: Exclusive club needs place to sleep on the lake

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
Erie is one of the Great Lakes

explanation.surface: A private club needs somewhere for members to sleep on the lake.
explanation.definitionFit: A select close-knit group excludes outsiders, like a clique.

clue.text: God who's angry when rejected

indicators.note: rejected means the word is turned back

parts.note: sore can mean angry or aggrieved

explanation.surface: A deity who is cross when spurned.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek deity of love is a god.

clue.text: Sea-creature made by worker with clay mostly

indicators.note: mostly means a letter of the craftsman's word is lost

parts.note: a potter shapes clay

explanation.surface: A sea animal is fashioned by a ceramic artist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' here trims the first letter, P, not the usual last.
explanation.definitionFit: The sea variety of this furry mammal lives in coastal waters.

clue.text: Imagine that! Going topless in fancy headwear

parts.note: to picture something is to imagine it

indicators.note: losing its first letter, the top of a word written down

explanation.surface: Imagine that: someone in fancy headgear removing their top!
explanation.definitionFit: A wide-brimmed decorated ladies' bonnet is a type of fancy headgear.

clue.text: Newspaper article leads with crime

indicators.note: leads with puts the word for an article before the paper

parts.note: the is the definite article
FT is the Financial Times

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece opens with a crime story.
explanation.definitionFit: Stealing is a criminal offence.

clue.text: Abridged contents of magazine

parts.note: a gun's magazine holds bullets, and the word for them is shortened

explanation.definitionFit: Cartridges loaded into a rifle's magazine are known by a shortened word for munitions.

clue.text: Pilot's instrument change takes time

indicators.note: takes means the word for change holds the other inside it

parts.note: to alter is to change
taken as written

explanation.surface: Changing a pilot's instrument takes time.
explanation.definitionFit: An aircraft gauge showing height above sea level is a pilot's instrument.

clue.text: Not quite a colour match

indicators.note: not quite means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: green is a colour

explanation.surface: A colour that almost matches.
explanation.definitionFit: To match is to correspond or be in accord.

clue.text: Slow in US city before right turn

parts.note: LA is Los Angeles
a go is a turn

explanation.surface: Traffic is slow in an American city before a right turn.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical direction meaning broad and slow.

clue.text: French asset perhaps gets one extremely nervous

parts.note: une is the French indefinite article, 'a'

indicators.note: perhaps hints that the letters of asset can be rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A French holding may make one very anxious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'French' gives UNE (French for 'a'); 'perhaps' rearranges ASSET with I (one) into ASIEST.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative of a word meaning anxious describes the most anxious state.
